content: {"episode_id":"ep-05089","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-22","necessity_paragraph":"The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that are concerning for arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0), with documented palpitations (R00.2) and dizziness (R42). The service is therefore medically necessary as documented in the submitted clinical indication note, and we request reconsideration of the CO-22 denial."}
